corrections.text: A bug stopped a ticket's remaining legs being graded once the ticket had lost, which left 297 legs ungraded for good and made legs look less reliable than they were. Those legs are now graded as their games finish: 274 done today (141 won, 122 lost, 3 pushed, 8 void) and 23 still waiting on games not yet played. No ticket's own result changed. 4 legs on 1 game the league never played (CHC @ SD on 2026-10-01, id 849840: the series ended before it) were voided, which settled 4 tickets that had been stuck open (2 won on the legs that stood, 2 pushed with nothing left). A won ticket with a void or pushed leg is now paid at the price of the legs that stood.
